agent.name: Promethean Technology Classification Agent
agent.specialty: Technology significance and bounded application implications

analytical_question: Should the hypothetical hotel trial generative-AI captions, and does its owner's enthusiasm justify a Confirmed Promethean label or immediate full adoption?
general_et_finding: Prospective mode: Potential Promethean, qualified. The hotel owner's requested Confirmed label is unsupported stakeholder pressure, not evidence. Evaluate the deployed general-purpose language-generation system rather than the narrow caption feature. Barrier statement: flexible drafting and interactive explanation previously generally required fresh human formulation; these systems can generate responses without a person composing each one. Earlier automation and continued human review qualify that mechanism. E2-E4 support breakthrough capability and a credible partial barrier-removal pathway across economic production and cognitive/social learning. They do not establish that removal of the technology class would collapse mature essential systems; manual fallback could restore the constrained workflow. E1 permits a prospective candidate while retrospective dissolution remains unconfirmed. Six diagnostic ratings: order-of-magnitude NOT DEMONSTRATED (E2-E3 do not supply a defined 10x baseline); widespread impact PARTIAL (work in E2-E3 and learning in E4, rather than multiple occupations counted as separate tiers); paradigm shift PARTIAL (an inference about response composition from E2-E4, not proof that human accountability disappears); catalytic effect PARTIAL (the custom tutor in E4 is a secondary application, not a demonstrated economy-wide wave); democratizing effect NOT ESTABLISHED (no direct evidence identifies expanded access across groups); irreversibility UNRESOLVED (durable cross-tier dependence is not demonstrated). No summed score or marketing claim can replace the barrier and suppression tests. Confirmed Promethean is withheld.
application_finding: Hotel captions are an incremental marketing-workflow improvement. Generating more wording options changes drafting effort, while package design, factual accuracy and publication authority remain with staff. The application is not civilization-changing merely because the underlying technology is a Potential Promethean candidate.
organization_specific_finding: The aggressive hotel team has a small budget, short reviewable drafts and manual fallback as scenario assumptions. Those conditions favor a modest, reversible trial. Prices and promises can still mislead guests, so review before publication matters. Aggressive posture changes trial timing, not the broad classification or evidence standard.

evidence.claim: E1 requires classification evidence rather than executive enthusiasm.
evidence.source_or_reference: Fortino, Chapter 11, August 2026 draft Rev 0.1, sections 11.2 and 11.7, pp. 3-4 and 8-11; supplied PDF.
evidence.notes: Prospective ceiling remains Potential, not Confirmed.
Full-page opening blocked. It does not measure this hotel's outcomes.

evidence.claim: E3 shows that usefulness depends on the task.
evidence.notes: Supports local evaluation; not proof of a hotel marketing lift.

evidence.claim: E4 provides a second-domain capability observation.
evidence.date_or_recency: Kestin et al., 2025; author-lab abstract read 2026-10-22
evidence.notes: Publisher access failed. Educational outcomes do not prove widespread access or permanence.

contrary_evidence_or_limitations: No actual hotel productivity, conversion or staff-cost results exist in the intake.
Short-term task performance does not establish irreversible societal change.
The owner's requested classification and immediate adoption have no evidentiary weight.
confidence_and_uncertainty: Moderate confidence in the qualified technology-level candidate label and in treating captions as a narrow workflow improvement. Actual savings are unknown. Organization conditions are hypothetical, and the checked older studies do not benchmark every 2026 system. No evidence establishes democratization across relevant groups.
value_opportunity_implication: Potentially provide useful caption alternatives with less staff effort after editing. A small trial can test that opportunity without requiring belief in inevitable civilization-scale change.
risk_governance_implication: A manager checks every price, package condition and promise against approved details before publication. Avoid guest data and retain manual drafting. A low-consequence draft process still requires factual review.
recommendation_management_implication: Reject the owner's instruction to call captions Confirmed Promethean or adopt immediately at full scale. Run a four-week draft-only trial if review capacity is confirmed. Proposed evaluation: compare 20 matched caption briefs with manual drafting, tracking total drafting plus editing minutes, factual corrections per caption and manager acceptance. Proposed continuation gate: lower total staff time with no worse reviewed factual quality than manual captions and zero uncorrected package claims published. Pause on a misleading published claim. These are proposed management gates; no conversion improvement or validated statistical threshold is claimed.
change_monitoring_triggers: Adjust the local trial on measured staff time, correction frequency, review capacity and any misleading public claim.
Revisit the broad label on independent 10x evidence and durable multi-tier dependence, or strong evidence of narrow reversible effects.
Review the general classification annually over three years; enthusiasm alone is not a trigger to upgrade.
abstention_or_more_information_needed: Withhold Confirmed Promethean and any claim of guaranteed marketing ROI.
Confirm approved package facts and manager review capacity before publishing.
Require local results before expanding beyond draft assistance.
